criteria_results.text: Stop, model, reasoning, and Fast controls appear only in the bottom composer while unique session-level actions remain in the header.
criteria_results.notes: The live Agents surface showed cost, Compact session, Prepare project, and Session actions in the header; Cancel running session, Agent, Model, Permission mode, Reasoning budget, Fast, and Attach files remained in the composer.

process_issues.description: Chrome initially retained the pre-edit React tree after navigating to the same development URL.
process_issues.detected_by: The accessibility tree still contained header Stop, model, reasoning, and Fast controls while curl of the served TSX showed they were absent; a forced reload synchronized the page before smoke evaluation.

suggested_follow_up: Keep the focused header-versus-composer assertions so future session-header changes cannot reintroduce duplicate run controls.
